items.title: Ruth Lion interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: you remember that song Elvis used to sing, the “Blue Suede Shoes?”

ctx.x: That was a magnificent time of his life. I know that meant the world to him. Here he is. And these are the guys, so many of the guys that he loved. There’s Bruce Lundwall. I don’t think Michael Cuscuna — Bobby Hutcherson, Kenny Burrell, Jimmy Smith, so many of the guys. And so he went through that. It was an ordeal. But the last day that we were there, Reid Miles by the way went over on the plane with us, which was wonderful because Reid was a riot. This guy, he was absolutely as wild as Alfred and Frank. And…

they were. And so they were very kind to us and everything. And then we went back home and he got word that they would like to have the Blue Note Festival at Mount Fuji. Well right away I said, “Alfred, no way, we can’t do that.” I mean we want to live, don’t we? Well I’ll have to show you this picture of him when his 70 — this was after cardiac arrest, I want to show you how good he looked, with the little blue suit on. He was a dandy, you know? This guy loved clothes. And so you see you remember that song Elvis…
